name: lanekeeper
description: Workbench for running parallel Claude Code agent lanes: model routing, lane and slot limits, git safety guards, handoff and review. Claude Code only (ships bin/ tools).

language.title: Message language
language.description: Language for Lanekeeper messages. auto follows the system locale. ~/.lanekeeper/personal.json overrides this value.

chat_detail.title: Chat report detail
chat_detail.description: summary keeps chat reports short and puts evidence in an artifact. detailed writes tables, evidence and figures in chat as well.
